items.title: Rome Odunze: Four catches in Week 11 win
items.text:
Odunze caught all four of his targets for 45 yards in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tony Pollard: Eclipses 100-yard mark vs. old squad
items.text:
Pollard rushed 21 times for 110 yards and failed to bring in his only target in the Titans' 51-30 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Javonte Williams: Two more TDs in Week 11 win
items.text:
Williams rushed 18 times for 67 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for 24 yards and another score in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Luther Burden: Quiet in win over Saints
items.text:
Burden caught two of three targets for 10 yards and added three yards on his only carry in Sunday's 21-13 win over New Orleans.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DeVonta Smith: Gets 12 targets in return
items.text:
Smith (hamstring) caught five of 12 targets for 41 yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.

items.title: Caleb Williams: Tosses two TDs in Week 11 win
items.text:
Williams completed 15 of 23 passes for 181 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints. He added 11 rushing yards on four carries.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: Scores 38-yard TD in Week 11 win
items.text:
Barkley rushed 17 times for 75 yards and a touchdown but wasn't targeted in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
